nom: BYOMA Brightening Toner with Lactic Acid

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the toner controls excess oil and reduces mid-day shine, with one saying it did not leave her oily and another noting less oiliness than her prior product.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: some report hydration without dryness or irritation, while one warns dry/acne-prone skin to avoid it after experiencing chemical burns and breakouts.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report the toner balances their skin, smooths texture, and helps with oiliness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most divided group: several report stinging, burning, redness, swelling or rashes (some calling it a chemical burn), while others say it caused no irritation at all and even repaired their barrier.
segments.mature: One reviewer notes the toner smoothed skin and reduced dark spots after a few weeks, describing it as restoring youthfulness to her face and neck.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it against aging report smoother texture and a firmer, more youthful look to face and neck after a few weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the toner hydrates without drying skin out, though one long-time toner user found it left her face feeling sticky and not fully dry even after moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report red bumps or red, irritated patches after use, sometimes fading over time, while others with redness-prone skin report no irritation and calming effects.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers say it helped restore a compromised skin barrier and left skin feeling calm; others, especially with sensitive or dry skin, report chemical burns, swelling, or rash suggesting barrier damage.
concerns.spots: Reviewers targeting dark spots and dullness report gradual lightening and a brighter, more even tone after two or more weeks of consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: many say it cleared blemishes, reduced hormonal acne and blackheads, while a notable group describes severe new breakouts, cystic pimples, or whiteheads especially in the first weeks.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers report the toner removes excess oil left after cleansing and reduces midday shine, with no reports of it making skin oilier.

aspects.libelle: Dispensing hole too large, wastes product

extraits.texte: my skin was clear before trying, two weeks later i have chemical burns and 10+ pimples on my face. if you're dry and acne prone do NOT buy!

extraits.titre: Gets the job done, but it's not for everyone
extraits.texte: The toner effectively tones the skin, leaving it feeling refreshed. However, the formula may not be suitable for those with sensitive skin types, leading to an itching and a stinging sensation upon application. While it achieves its primary function, its potential for skin discomfort could be a concern for individuals with sensitive skin like mine.

I purchased this to add to my skincare routine two or three times a week- not as a daily toner. The glycolic acid exfoliator I was using just was not giving the results I would like so I wanted to try something new and this was something in a decent price range that would not break the bank. The bottle says for use twice a day, but I really don't recommend that unless you have super oily skin otherwise you will compromise your skin barrier. It did sting a bit after I put it on, but that usually happens with all acids I use. It went away in about 2 minutes or less, I used azelaic acid to target some acne spots I had, added moisturizer, and went to bed. Woke up to nice, bright skin. Did not break me out more. For reference I am 30, with acne-prone normal to dry skin now that I am getting older.

I have heard good things about Byoma, I've seen many videos on social media and reviews praising their skincare line. I'm a 19 year old girl who has always struggled with acne since I started puberty. Recently I started a birth control pill and had some hormonal breakouts (worse than the ones I experienced pre-pill) since I was adjusting to new hormones. First I bought their serums and then I wanted to buy a toner that actually helped my skin, having had an exceptional experience with their serums I decided to try their toner. Just as their serums blew my mind, their toner did the same thing! This toner is great. My skin can be sensitive at times and have reactions to certain ingredients but I have NEVER had a problem with Byoma so far. This toner does what it says, it softens and smoothes my skin, which has helped with my skin texture and acne A TON. I use their Clarifying, Brightening, and Hydrating Serums everyday as well as their Toner and my skin has thanked me. As for the applicator, I saw reviews saying it was just a big hole and too much product would come out. But my bottle when opened had a smaller clear plastic/silicone covering with a tiny hole. Keeps from a lot of product flowing out. I feel like they fixed their previous complaints with this.
It stings a lottle but wow she makes my skin look pretty. I have sensitive & acne prone skin, this did not break me out at all. Hallelujah!
I have kp which basically means my skin doesn't exfoliate itself which causes tiny little bumps on my face. The lactic acid in here made them SO much better.

The Brightening Toner is the first product I've tried from Byoma and I was surprised at how great of a product it is. There was no burning from the lactic acid like I've had with products before, which is great forvmy sensitive skin. It helps control oil, helps restore my compromised skin barrier, and it's so affordable! It's hard to find skincare that doesn't irritate my skin that's still affordable. I look forward to trying some of the other Byoma products!
